profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Qualcomm. UCSD Alumni. Former Xamarin Student Ambassador.
profile.summary:
Computer Engineer. Have excellent programming, databases, and systems modeling skills. I strive to produce scalable, robust, rigorously tested, and high performing software. Broad experience in application architecture and development applying Object Oriented Programming, Test Driven Development and Software Design Patterns.

I am motivated to lead teams to success by applying cutting-edge technologies, and agile software methodologies while facing new challenges, and where the use of strong analytic skills and complex problem solving is prevalent. I have varied experience working with different platforms and environments, namely Windows, Linux, Mac, servers on-premise and on the cloud, and development boards such as Raspberry Pi, Qualcomm’s DragonBoard and Arduino.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Wireless Network/Device Performance:
Part of a group of wireless networking engineers helping to overcome todays and tomorrows challenges in the latest wireless technologies (LTE, WCDMA, CDMA) in ways of designing and defining the next generation wireless communication technologies.

Functions:
- Design and implementation of algorithms to analyze network and device logs.
- Smartphone software development and data analysis.
- Work with wireless carriers, and with smartphone manufacturers in order to analyze smartphone OS performance.

Technologies and areas of Software Engineering: 
LTE, WCDMA, CDMA, Android/iOS, Telecommunications (wireless technologies), DB management and query using SQL, OOP, Statistics.

positions.title: Xamarin Student Partner
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Design and development of iOS iPhone app and .NET SOAP Web Services for the Tijuana’s baseball team “Toros de Tijuana”, along with synchronization scripts that copies information from external servers to the company's ones.

- Design and development of Gasmart mobile application for iOS (iPhone and iPad).

- .NET Windows Forms desktop application that integrates the DNS Made Easy service used to maintain stations' DNS records updated with the help of an ASP.NET Windows Azure Website.

- Windows Forms and Console application that sends/receives SMS messages in a Client/Server architecture through AT commands. The application serves as a backup protocol activated when stations don't have a live Internet connection.

- Functionality and design implementation in company's private iOS (iPhone/iPad) app.

- ASP.NET MVC Web application used by authenticated Active Directory users to download internal app binaries and public mobile Android/iOS/Windows phone applications.

- New technologies research, focusing in cloud computing, mobile and web development for new projects.

- Scrum Agile methodology.

Technologies used: C#, Xamarin.iOS, ASP.NET MVC, WCF and .NET web services, MS SQL Server/CE, MySQL, SQLite, Entity Framework, IIS, XML, HTML5, CSS3, JS/jQuery, Windows Azure, Team Foundation Server, Git, AT commands.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- School's website lead web developer & designer, integrating the ASP .NET MVC based Orchard CMS open source solution as a cloud service with Windows Azure.

- Database modeling, and lead software developer for the capture, PDF, and statistics generation Windows Forms .NET with Infragistics UI desktop application "Clinic History", used by the school's health department.

Technologies used: ASP.NET MVC, MS SQL Server, IIS, XML, C#, HTML5, CSS3, JS/jQuery, Windows Azure, Orchard CMS, .NET Windows Forms, MySQL, Infragistics, Team Foundation Server.

positions.title: Assistant Professor
positions.description: Assistant Professor for the Fundamentals of Research class of Fall 2012 with 30+ Computer Systems Engineering students.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Experience on software engineering of mobile Android applications under the Enterprise Communication Division.

Development and testing of functional and nonfunctional requirements of an existing application that serves as a medium to improve security for cargo containers including:

- Implementation of new authentication method to provide a more secure way of accessing the application through the use of the baiMobile 301MP Smart Card Reader, that supports the standard ISO 7816 smart cards issued by the US Government (CAC and PIV).

- Implementation of new GUI design for the application, in order to improve the UX providing a consistent design with the Android OS that follows the Google's UI design guidelines.

Technologies used: Java, Android, JS/jQuery, XML, HTML 5, CSS3, Git.

projects.title: VR App for the Visually Impaired (VRVI) - 2015 Qualcomm's HackMobile Best Civil Hack
projects.description: VR App that provided users with text-to-speech and speech-to-text functionality for classifying, localizing & searching keywords by image similarity.

projects.title: Mystro - 2015 UCLA's LAHacks Best iOS App / Best Microsoft Hack
projects.description: Mystro was born out of our initiative to provide students and institutions with a powerful tool that can revolutionize students' performance and parents involvement. As college mentors/professors, we always work towards developing resources to better assist schools and students. Therefore, we initiated and constructed a system that reflects both of our experiences as mentors/professors and the needs that thousands of students have. We are convinced that there are many factors that affect student performance that go beyond academics. For this reason our system does not conform to the success of few but rather continues to evolve to become as personalized as needed to guarantee the success of each and every student!
